title: CPSC, Bush Hog, LLC Announce Recall of Utility Vehicles
summary: The front suspension A-frame can break or separate from the front wheel and cause a loss of steering ability, resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall of Lov's Pacifiers
summary: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests when the nipples separated from the base. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 180,000.

title: CPSC, Dollar General Corp. Announce Recall of Metal Heart-Shaped Pendants
summary: The recalled heart-shaped pendant contains high levels of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Pamela Drake Inc. Announce Recall of Wooden Push Toys
summary: Small parts can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, PBteen Announce Recall for Replacement of Glass Drawer Knobs
summary: The glass knobs can break when over-tightened or when pressure is applied, exposing a sharp edge. Units: 28,000.

title: CPSC, Midwest Folding Products Announce Recall to Repair Optional Guard Rails on Standing Choral Risers
summary: Choral risers equipped with an optional guard rail can tip over under certain loading conditions, which poses a risk of injury from falling from the risers. Units: About 7,000 guard rails.

title: CPSC, RadioShack Announce Recall of Video Head Cleaner
summary: The cleaning solution bottle, which is labeled as containing isopropanol, actually contains methanol. Methanol can be fatal or cause blindness if swallowed. It is much more toxic than isopropanol. Also, the cleaning solution bottle does not have special cautionary labeling and child-resistant packag

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Pogo Sticks
summary: An internal metal pin can wear down, causing the pogo sticks to remain stuck in the down position and release unexpectedly, posing a risk of fall or facial impact injuries to children. Units: About 154,000.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Push Toys
summary: A young child's chin, jaw, and teeth can get lodged in the opening at the top of the push toy's round-shaped handle and incur injuries. Units: About 54,000.

title: CPSC, Cimberio S.p.A. and Dormont Manufacturing Company Announce Recall of Certain Cimberio Gas Valves
summary: When one of these valves is closed, it could open up slightly. If the gas supply is on, gas will leak from the inlet port through the ball/seat and travel through the outlet port. If the valve is not connected to an appliance, and is not capped or plugged, as required by the National Fuel Gas Code S

title: CPSC, Holmes Group Announce Recall of Portable Electric Heaters
summary: Some heaters have improperly crimped wires, which can result in overheating and a potential thermal burn or fire hazard. Units: About 13,500.

title: CPSC, Quality Bicycle Products Announce Recall of Bicycle Handlebar Stems
summary: These handlebar stems can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Jake's Fireworks Inc. Announce Recall of Fireworks
summary: The aerial shells are fused, shaped, and labeled in a way that could cause consumers to unintentionally place them into the launch tube upside down, resulting in a ground-level explosion. Such an explosion can cause serious injuries to consumers in close proximity of the device. Units: About 75,000

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of Select Model Year 2004.5 and 2005 Sportsman and 2005 Model Year Scrambler ATVs
summary: Some 2004.5 and 2005 Model Year Sportsman and 2005 Model Year Scrambler 500 ATVs were assembled with possibly defective Electronic Control Modules (ECM), which may fail and overheat. If this were to occur, excessive heat could cause a fire, possibly resulting in serious injury or death. Units: About

title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: The white paint on the cribs can chip, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 575.

title: CPSC, Summit Marketing International LLC Announce Recall to Repair Children's Folding Chairs
summary: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cut hazard. This can cause severe lacerations and fingertip amputations to children's fingers. Units: 2

title: CPSC, Apple Announce Recall of iBook and PowerBook Computer Batteries
summary: An internal short can cause the battery cells to overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 128,000 units (in the United States).

title: CPSC, Carter Brothers Manufacturing Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Fun-Kart Go-Karts
summary: A wheel could separate from the go-kart, posing a roll-over hazard. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of Select Model Year 2004 and 2005 Snowmobiles
summary: The fuel tank filler neck may develop a crack at the base where the filler neck meets the fuel tank assembly. This may cause the neck to separate from the fuel tank assembly and allow fuel to escape from the tank, potentially creating a fire hazard. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, Cascade Designs, Inc. Announce Recall of Stove Fuel
summary: A manufacturing defect in the can's seam and an insufficiently applied fuel cap can cause the can to leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,500.

title: CPSC, Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Circular Saws
summary: The lower blade guard can malfunction, creating a risk of injury as severe as amputation. Units: 69,000.

title: CPSC, Ethan Allen Announce Recall of Two Dining Tables
summary: These dining room tables can be missing sufficient stability blocks. That could result in the table collapsing. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, Michaels of Oregon Announce Recall of Handgun Holsters
summary: The holster's retention strap can move out of position and could cause a handgun to unexpectedly discharge while being reholstered, posing a serious injury risk to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Cables To Go Announce Recall of Power Adapters Sold with Go!Data Drive Enclosures
summary: A component inside the adapters can overheat, posing a risk of fire or electrical shock. Units: About 3,100.

title: CPSC, Hitachi Cable Manchester Inc. Announce Recall of 25- and 50-Pair Plenum Network Cables
summary: The recalled cables do not meet the fire resistance standards for cable used in plenum applications. title: CPSC, Home Interiors & Gifts Inc. Announce Recall of Candle Tins
summary: The candle flames could flare up out of the tin container during use, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 300,000.

title: CPSC, ITECH Announce Recall of Hockey Goalie Masks and Replacement Wires
summary: The metal wire on these products could break at or near a weld point, exposing a hockey goalie to facial injuries. Units: About 5,000.
